glm-provider__01_a.md.title: Microsoft 365 Consultant
glm-provider__01_a.md.about_headline: Microsoft 365 tenant builds, mail platform migrations and identity hardening for Singapore clinics, schools and SMEs
glm-provider__01_a.md.about_bio: I have spent 7 years building and fixing Microsoft 365 environments for small and mid-sized Singapore organisations. My earlier roles were in a Singapore-based medical group's IT department, a Singapore-based managed services provider's cloud team, and a private education group's technology office. I hold a bachelor's degree in information systems from a local autonomous university. Since going independent, my work has centred on clinic groups, training providers and trade associations: consolidating ageing mail servers into clean tenants, and tightening sign-in controls under PDPA.

services.service_title: Microsoft 365 Tenant Build and Mail Migration
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore businesses still running mail on ageing on-premises servers or a single shared hosting account. Services include tenant provisioning and domain verification, mailbox, calendar and contact migration, shared mailbox and distribution group setup, DNS record changes with a rollback window, and an admin handover pack. Includes PDPA-aligned admin role separation. Engagements typically run three to six weeks.

services.service_title: MFA Rollout and Admin Access Hardening
services.service_detail: For Singapore SMEs that need sign-in controls tightened before a client audit or a PDPA review. Services include conditional access policy design and deployment, privileged role separation, legacy authentication lockdown, staff MFA enrolment sessions, and a short baseline document for internal admins. I do not carry out penetration testing or broader cybersecurity reviews.

achievements: Migrated 14 mailboxes for a three-clinic dental group over a single weekend, completing DNS cutovers with no lost messages.
Consolidated 41 on-premises Exchange mailboxes into one tenant for a tuition centre chain within five weeks.
Configured conditional access and separated admin roles for 26 accounts at a trade association, clearing all findings from an external PDPA gap review.
Built a shared mailbox and distribution list structure for an 18-person civil engineering practice, replacing four informal group inboxes.
Ran a phased MFA enrolment for 60 staff at a family-owned F&B chain, reaching full coverage in nine working days.
glm-provider__01_a.md.how_i_work: I start every engagement with an inventory and a written migration plan that the business signs off. Work happens in small batches: a pilot group first, then the rest cut over outside office hours. I document admin steps as I go, so internal staff can run routine tasks themselves once I leave.

glm-provider__01_b.md.title: Microsoft 365 Deployment Engineer
glm-provider__01_b.md.about_headline: Microsoft 365 tenant setup, email migration and identity hardening for Singapore SMEs
glm-provider__01_b.md.about_bio: I am a Microsoft 365 engineer with 6 years of experience moving Singapore small and mid-sized businesses onto managed email and identity platforms. I started in a Singapore-based retail group's IT department, moved to a Singapore-based IT services firm's cloud productivity team, and later worked in a healthcare group's IT infrastructure team. I hold an information systems degree from a Singapore university. Now independent, I build tenants, migrate mail and harden accounts for SME clients myself.

services.service_title: Microsoft 365 Tenant Setup for SMEs
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore businesses setting up company email and identity for the first time or moving off informal setups. Services include tenant provisioning and domain verification, licensed mailbox, shared mailbox and distribution list configuration, security group and admin role separation, MFA enforcement across all accounts, and setup documentation, with configurations aligned to the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

services.service_title: Email Migration and DNS Cutover
services.service_detail: For Singapore businesses moving staff off consumer-grade or legacy hosted mail onto a company-managed platform. Services include a pre-migration inventory of mailboxes and data volumes, staged migration of mail, calendar and contact data, DNS record cutover with MX and SPF changes, post-migration checks on desktop and mobile clients, and a concise handover document. I schedule the cutover outside trading hours.

achievements: Built and handed over a Microsoft 365 tenant for a 22-staff F&B chain, with 24 mailboxes and 4 shared mailboxes live in under two weeks.
Migrated 18 users from a legacy hosted provider to a new tenant for a construction SME across three weekends with no lost mail.
Configured MFA on all 35 staff accounts at a tuition centre group and split administrator duties across three role groups before a PDPA review.
Cut DNS cutover downtime to under 90 minutes for a wholesale distributor's 26 mailboxes, verified the same afternoon.
glm-provider__01_b.md.how_i_work: I begin with a short inventory of mailboxes, data volumes and devices, then build the tenant and test with a small pilot group. I migrate in batches outside working hours, verify mail flow and access before switching DNS, and close with a plain-language handover so your own staff can run things.

glm-provider__01_d.md.title: Data Protection Practitioner
glm-provider__01_d.md.about_headline: Hands-on data protection work for Singapore clinics and SMEs: policies, registers, breach readiness and PDPA compliance.
glm-provider__01_d.md.about_bio: I have spent 7 years in data protection work, starting in a Singapore-based hospital group's compliance office, moving to a privacy consultancy's SME practice, and now working independently as a data protection practitioner for clinics and small businesses across Singapore. I hold a bachelor's degree in information systems from a local university. My work is hands-on: I draft the policies, build the data inventories and set up the registers that keep clients compliant with the PDPA.

services.service_title: Outsourced Data Protection Officer Retainer
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore businesses, particularly medical and dental clinics, that must appoint a data protection officer but do not need one full time. Services include drafting data protection policies and consent wording, building a data inventory across patient and staff records, running breach assessments and PDPC notifications, and delivering staff briefings. Retainer covers ongoing compliance tasks; one-off system changes are quoted separately.

services.service_title: PDPA Gap Review and Remediation
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized Singapore businesses facing a tender requirement, investor due diligence or a PDPC query that calls for documented compliance. Services include a gap review against PDPC advisory guidelines, drafting remediation policies and staff procedures, reworking collection notices and consent flows, implementing retention and disposal schedules, and preparing a close-out report for management. Covers documentation and process work only; no technical testing.

achievements: Drafted and rolled out a complete policy set for an eight-clinic dental group, closing 42 register gaps in six weeks.
Built a data inventory covering 35 systems for a four-outlet physiotherapy chain and cut its breach response steps from 11 to 4.
Ran the analysis for a tuition centre's misplaced paper records incident and had the PDPC notification ready within 48 hours.
Implemented retention and disposal schedules across 3,000 patient files for a home-care nursing startup ahead of an investor review.
Prepared and delivered PDPA briefings to 120 frontline staff across three aesthetic clinics in one quarter.
glm-provider__01_d.md.how_i_work: I work on site or alongside your team through each step: I sit with staff to map how records actually move, draft the documents myself, set up the working files and registers, and rehearse the breach process with the front desk before I hand over. You get working artefacts, not a slide deck.

glm-provider__01_e.md.title: Inventory and Stock Control Specialist
credentials: APICS Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM)

services.service_title: Stock Control Setup and Stock-Take Programme
services.service_detail: For small and mid-sized furniture, homeware and hardware retailers in Singapore. Services include building the item master and SKU catalogue, configuring a barcode-based inventory platform, setting reorder points and supplier lead-time buffers, drafting cycle-count and annual stock-take procedures, and training storeroom and sales staff on daily routines. One business, up to three sites, per engagement.

services.service_title: Storeroom Setup and Receiving Workflows
services.service_detail: For independent retailers and importers running a single stockroom or small distribution store. Services include planning racking and bin locations, implementing goods-receiving and put-away checklists, drafting transfer paperwork between shopfloor and storeroom, building shrinkage and damaged-stock logs, and running the first full stock-take to a verified count. One site per assignment.

achievements: Cut a furniture showroom's stock-take variance from 8.2% to under 2% within three months by introducing weekly cycle counts.
Implemented barcode receiving for a homeware importer carrying 4,000 SKUs, shortening dock-to-shelf time from two days to four hours.
Rationalised a sporting goods retailer's catalogue from 6,500 to 4,200 SKUs, releasing about S$180,000 of working capital from slow-moving stock.
Built a reorder-point system that kept a neighbourhood hardware store's fill rate above 95% through two Chinese New Year peaks.
glm-provider__01_e.md.how_i_work: I start on the shopfloor, counting and observing before touching any system. I configure and load the data myself, write checklists in plain language, run the first counts alongside your staff, and stay through the first month so the routines hold without me.
